title: Kirby Problem 3.49
exact_target: For prime rational homology spheres, does existence of a contact structure with a symplectic filling having a positive intersection direction characterize each of the three L-space-conjecture conditions?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2847 (KP-3.49). CC BY 4.0.
